messages:
maria: Quick poll — final topic choices for the May webinar, need a pick today. Options: 1) Inference TCO for startups (benchmarks + cost controls) 2) Serving at scale: graceful fallbacks & rollouts 3) Latency & cost wins with caching/batching. Plan: 45m presentation + 15m live Q&A. Who can lead and who are proposed speakers?
alex: I vote for #2 — Serving at scale. We can highlight Dedicated + Private fallbacks and routing policies. Priya + Ben would be great speakers for the tech side. :raised_hands:
jordan: I can co-present a customer case study for the TCO angle — startup we worked with cut inference costs ~3x. That could slot into either #1 or as a demo in #2.
sam: Design can make a simple explainer for caching vs batching. Timeline?
maria: Timeline: abstracts due Tue 5/5. Rehearsal week of 5/11. Marketing assets ready by 5/8. Registration page live by 5/10 ideally.
lee: Availability check — prefer 5/20 or 5/27. I can book rooms+recording for either.
alex: Proposed speaker lineup if we go #2: Priya (runtime), Ben (SRE/fallbacks), Jordan (customer demo). Maria you moderate?
maria: I can moderate. Need short abstracts (60–80 words) + 3 bullet takeaways per speaker. Also a 1-paragraph event blurb for the landing page.
jordan: I'll draft the startup TCO abstract by EOD and a 5–7 minute demo script.
priya: (tagged) happy to lead runtime section — will add fallback examples. @ben can we get latency graphs?
sam: Slide deadlines: I need final copy + assets by 5/12 to build the deck and motion graphics.
maria: Draft run-of-show (tight 45 + 15):
```
00:00 - 00:05 - Intro + house rules (maria)
00:05 - 00:20 - Runtime & fallback patterns (Priya)
00:20 - 00:35 - Customer demo & TCO story (Jordan)
00:35 - 00:45 - Panel highlights + quick ops checklist (Priya, Ben, Jordan)
00:45 - 01:00 - Live audience Q&A (all)
```
Can we tighten slides to fit 45m main? suggest talk blocks 15+15+10.
alex: Looks good. Add a slide for the fallback decision matrix and ask SRE for KV cache hit-rate graphs.
lee: I booked 5/20 10:00 AM PT for the webinar slot and recording studio. calendar-bot: Event added -> https://cal.example.com/event/1723456789
calendar-bot: Added "Webinar: Serving at Scale" to #marketing calendar — 5/20 10:00 PT
maria: Action items: Alex -> fallback slide + request SRE metrics; Jordan -> draft abstract + demo script; Sam -> slide deck template + motion; Lee -> finalize reg page + CTA. I'll collect all abstracts by Tue 5/5.
alex: Noted. I'll ping Ben and SRE for graphs and latency tables. @ben please post KV cache numbers in thread.
jordan: Doing demo script now, will do a dry run with Alex next Thu.
sam: Brand review deadline request — can we do a quick pass by 5/13? DM me any brand assets.
maria: Great — we'll lock topic as "Serving at scale: graceful fallbacks & rollouts" unless any objections by EOD. If you prefer another topic, flag now. :thumbsup:
alex: +1
lee: +1
jordan: +1
sam: +1
maria: Closing thread — dropping notes into the webinar doc and handing off to ops for calendar invites. Thanks everyone!
